none: No cases yet. Cases appear when a person shares with a counsellor.
label: Label
needs_signoff: Nothing is labelled clinical advice until a counsellor signs off.
denied: Access is not permitted: the person revoked or the permission expired.
coverage: Share of simulated incompatible couples covered by a card
pending: Not run yet: needs the user test
fairness: Fairness by language and literacy (groups under 5 hidden)
scope_title: What this person chose to share
scope_none: Only that they want to talk
res_incompatible: both carry a change in the same gene
scope_rule: Anything they did not agree to share is not shown. Opening this case is written to their activity log.
question: Their question
opt_3: Other reproductive options, such as testing embryos (PGT-M).
opt_4: Telling relatives, if and how the couple wish.
draft_ai: Draft prepared by AI. Check before use.
pick_case: Choose a case to see what was shared.
synthetic_warning: SYNTHETIC: made-up answers with an assumed effect, only to show the pipeline. Not a study result.
understanding_note: Share of correct answers to the same 3 questions after a lab letter and after the AMANA card.
fairness_note: By reading comfort. Groups under 5 people are hidden.
cost_note: At 10,000 couples a year; hosting only. Assumptions to confirm.
cross_lab_note: Partners tested at different labs still match.
rollout_note: Abu Dhabi → UAE → Saudi Arabia: panel, language and directory change without code.
routing: Simulated cases routed to the right tier
invites_note: Totals only. No sender, no gene.
attack_line: An attacker claims every gene on the panel. Plain hash matching reveals the partner's genes; AMANA rejects the claim.
